deviations: MS-1/MS-2/MS-3 acceptance criteria require behavioral tests, but each task's scope listed only source files (and, for MS-2, locales.spec.ts) and no dedicated component/worker spec path. Added co-located spec files src/sw.spec.ts, src/components/update-prompt.spec.tsx, and src/App.spec.tsx to satisfy the required tests. These are the natural co-located test locations for the in-scope source files.

The repo has no jsdom/@testing-library/react. Component tests render via react-dom/client under a per-file `// @vitest-environment happy-dom` docblock (happy-dom is already present transitively) and mock the virtual:pwa-register/react and react-i18next modules. No package.json or shared vitest config was touched.

MS-3 double-registration criterion is met by configuration rather than code: injectRegister defaults to 'auto', and because the app now imports virtual:pwa-register/react (via useRegisterSW), the plugin does not also auto-inject a registration script, so exactly one SW registration occurs and navigator.serviceWorker.ready still resolves.
